title: Mailbox send docs don't say an idempotency key is unique across all of a sender's recipients
outcome: A sender who reuses an idempotency key for a different recipient learns from the tool description and the refusal text that the key's scope is the sender across all recipients, and which key to change.
acceptance: The `termal_send_to_session` description and `mailbox send` help say the key is unique per sender across all recipients, so parallel sends to two recipients need two keys.
The 409 refusal text says the same in plain words and still refuses; idempotency behaviour itself doesn't change, and a test covers the refusal for a second recipient.
